title: 第15章 赐婚第16章 四朝比试
slug: 穿成皇子六连抽建立万古帝朝
lines: 萧鼎锋看着其他的皇子都离开了，便对萧风说：“你现在也已经满十八了，朕准备给你找个王妃。”
萧风听后直接愣住了，啥？这是要给我找媳妇了？虽然在乾坤大陆年满十八就成年了，但是这也太荒谬了吧，一个月前，还是在冷宫不受重视的皇子，现在这是直接要给赐婚了？真是搞不懂啊。但是还是开口道：“父皇，这不着急吧，我才刚刚开府。”
“每个皇子都是开府之后会有赐婚，今天之所以没有在朝堂上过多的停留，就是想和你商量这件事，其他的皇子都是他们各自背后的世家挑选的，你有什么想法？”
“儿臣，不想这么早结婚。”萧风只是说了自己真实的想法。
萧鼎锋看着萧风说道：“这件事不由你，即使现在你不定下来，明天各大世家的联姻就会招上朕，你觉得到时候你还有得选吗？”
萧风也是很无奈的，知道萧鼎锋说的是实话，因为现在还是要依靠世家维持，虽然萧鼎锋上台后削弱了一些世家的影响力，但是现在世家的影响力还是很大的。
萧鼎锋还是开口道：“我给你找了个好的王妃，呼延墨岩的儿女，呼延欢颜，你应该是见过了吧？”
萧风听着萧鼎锋的话，心中已经知道，萧鼎锋已经决定好了，所以也没有反驳，只是回道：“全凭父皇安排。”
萧鼎锋看着萧风一脸无奈的样子，笑道：“你如果娶了呼延欢颜，最少在朝堂上你才能有点声音，要不然你准备怎么去破局？今天朝堂之上，你也看的很明白，你不要抵触，呼延欢颜是个很好的女子，修炼天赋也不错，现在也是黄阶五级的修为，在同龄人中也是个佼佼者。”
萧风只能是点头，因为萧鼎锋说的确实是他的一个弱点，因为他在朝堂确实是没有说的上话的人。
随后萧鼎锋让萧风先回去，明日早朝上萧鼎锋会宣布这个消息。
当萧风离开后，呼延墨岩从屏风后面走出来，萧鼎锋一脸笑意的看着呼延墨岩，“怎么样，朕给你女儿挑的夫婿是否还满意？”
呼延墨岩也是一脸无奈的看着萧鼎锋，终于明白之前那句你觉得怎么样，是在说什么了，只能说：“全凭陛下做主。”
萧鼎锋也是笑了起来解释道：“老七不是你想的那么简单的，他才刚从冷宫中出来几天，身边已经汇集了一群高手了，而且燕京城中最近也出现了很多不明身份的势力，大概率是老七的人，你刚刚有感受到老七的实力吗？”
呼延墨岩这才反应过来，但是回想了一下，萧风身上好像没有气息波动，随即便摇了摇头，说：“没有，臣没有感受到汉王殿下身上有气息波动。”
萧鼎锋说：“老七现在能轻易的击杀你，而且他在不动用气息的情况下，看着就像是普通人一样。”
呼延墨岩听着萧鼎锋的话，心中满是不可思议，因为他已经是玄阶一级了，而且他的天赋本来就不高，能到玄阶都是萧鼎锋用丹药堆出来的，所以当萧鼎锋说萧风已经能轻易击杀他的时候，心中才充满了不可思议。
呼延墨岩有一儿一女，儿子从军，天赋也不是很高，女儿呼延欢颜天赋很高，当时测的时候是地阶三级，所以呼延墨岩一直很注重对呼延欢颜的培养，而他儿子呼延熊焱也是对这个妹妹很是疼爱，所以呼延欢颜是从小在这宠爱中长大的，他得赶紧回家去告知呼延欢颜，主要是怕呼延欢颜做出些什么出格的事情，于是便向萧鼎锋告辞，回府去了。
萧鼎锋看着离开的呼延墨岩，对刘雨说道：“你说老七能得到呼延墨岩的承认吗？”
刘雨站在一旁，心想，你都那样说了，他不承认是能怎么样了？他又不敢抗旨，但是还是回复道：“七殿下乃人中龙凤，肯定是能收获丞相大人的认可的。”
萧鼎锋没有说话，只是笑了笑，便拿起奏章，继续批阅。
萧风出了皇宫，直接上了马车，许褚驾车离开，刚到汉王府，萧风直接让曹正淳喊来了贾诩，到了书房。

等众人到了书房，萧风将赐婚的事情说了出来，一时间，大家都没有说话，贾诩沉默片刻之后，便对萧风说道：“殿下，赐婚的事情，对您来说可以说是很大机遇，而且陛下态度坚决，那么你怎么反抗都是无效的，而且陛下说的没错，朝堂之上的势力，您确实是没有，所以陛下直接让丞相站在你身后，能给我们增加不少助力了，我现在让袁天罡送一些丞相府的资料过来，也让一些人去保护一下呼延欢颜，我怕这个消息传出去后，有些人对丞相府出手。”
“嗯，你现在去安排吧，记得，安排些高手，确保万无一失。”萧风听完贾诩的分析，也是开口回道。
“曹正淳，最近府中有什么大事吗？”
“回殿下，没有，之前跟来的禁军都入了汉王府的编制，高凯也突破黄阶了，现在是玄阶高手，护龙山庄和锦衣卫的人也安排到了那300人的编制中了，小顺子也将宫中的势力分布和我都说了，我也告知贾诩了。”
“高凯这么快就到玄阶了？”萧风也是很疑惑，明明之前才是黄阶四级。
“是的，华神医炼了很多丹药，而且副作用极小，最近不良人和护龙山庄的人员，都有不同程度的提升，所以焦旭就让高凯那些人也开始服用了丹药了，但是玄阶之后，贾诩就让他们先都停止了。”
“嗯，你们做的不错，无论怎么样，提升实力总是没有错的。”
萧风从系统仓库中找了些丹药、功法还有兵器之类的，都交给了曹正淳，让他做完奖励，发给高凯那些人，最重要的是提高忠诚度，毕竟曹正淳对这些事情很熟练，但是如果有敢背叛的，直接杀了就行了，反正也是他的府兵，谁也管不到。
曹正淳拿着东西走后，萧风又开始了修炼，华佗也给炼制了很多丹药，他可以一直吃，反正对他来说，这些丹药几乎都没有什么副作用。

content_en:
Xiao Dingfeng watched the other princes leave, and said to Xiao Feng: "You are now eighteen, and I am going to find you a princess."
Xiao Feng was stunned after hearing this, what? Are you looking for a wife for me? Although one becomes an adult at the age of eighteen in Qiankun Continent, isn't this too ridiculous? A month ago, the prince was still ignored in the cold palace, and now he is going to be directly given a marriage? I really don’t understand. But he still said: "Father, don't worry, I have just opened the mansion."
"Every prince will be given a marriage after opening a palace. The reason why I didn't stay too much in the court today is because I want to discuss this matter with you. The other princes were selected by the families behind them. What do you think?"
"My son, I don't want to get married so early." Xiao Feng just said his true thoughts.
Xiao Dingfeng looked at Xiao Feng and said: "This matter is not up to you. Even if you don't decide now, I will be involved in the marriage of major families tomorrow. Do you think you still have a choice then?"
Xiao Feng is also very helpless, knowing that Xiao Dingfeng is telling the truth, because now he still has to rely on aristocratic families to maintain his power. Although Xiao Dingfeng has weakened the influence of some aristocratic families after coming to power, the influence of aristocratic families is still very strong now.
Xiao Dingfeng still said: "I have found a good princess for you, Huyan Moyan's son and daughter, Huyan Huanyan, you must have met her, right?"
After listening to Xiao Dingfeng's words, Xiao Feng already knew in his heart that Xiao Dingfeng had already made his decision, so he did not refute, but just replied: "It all depends on the arrangement of the father."
Xiao Dingfeng looked at Xiao Feng's helpless look and said with a smile: "If you marry Hu Yanhuanyan, at least you will have some voice in the court. Otherwise, how are you going to break the situation? Today in the court, you can see it very clearly. Don't resist. Huyanhuanyan is a very good woman with good talent in cultivation. She is now at the fifth level of the Yellow Rank and is also a leader among her peers."
Xiao Feng could only nod, because what Xiao Dingfeng said was indeed a weakness of his, because he really didn't have the right person to speak to in the court.
Then Xiao Dingfeng asked Xiao Feng to go back first, and Xiao Dingfeng would announce the news tomorrow morning.
After Xiao Feng left, Huyan Moyan walked out from behind the screen. Xiao Dingfeng looked at Huyan Moyan with a smile on his face, "How are you? Are you satisfied with the husband I chose for your daughter?"
Huyan Moyan also looked at Xiao Dingfeng helplessly. He finally understood what he was talking about when he said what do you think before. He could only say: "It's all up to your Majesty."
Xiao Dingfeng also laughed and explained: "Lao Qi is not as simple as you think. He has just come out of the cold palace for a few days, and he has already gathered a group of masters around him. Moreover, many unidentified forces have appeared in Yanjing City recently. It is most likely that they are Lao Qi's people. Did you feel Lao Qi's strength just now?"
Only then did Huyan Moyan react, but after thinking about it, there seemed to be no aura fluctuations on Xiao Feng's body, and then he shook his head and said, "No, I didn't feel any aura fluctuations on His Highness the King of Han's body."
Xiao Dingfeng said: "Lao Qi can easily kill you now, and he looks like an ordinary person without using his breath."
When Huyan Moyan listened to Xiao Dingfeng's words, his heart was full of disbelief, because he was already at the first level of the Xuan level, and his talent was not high in the first place. He was able to reach the Xuan level only because Xiao Dingfeng used pills. Therefore, when Xiao Dingfeng said that Xiao Feng could easily kill him, his heart was filled with disbelief.
Huyan Moyan has a son and a daughter. The son is in the army and his talent is not very high. His daughter Huyan Huanyan is very talented. She was at the third level of the earth level when she was tested. Therefore, Huyan Moyan has always paid attention to the cultivation of Huyan Huanyan, and his son Huyan Xiongyan is also very talented. He loved this sister very much, so Huyan Huanyan grew up with this love. He had to go home quickly to tell Huyan Huanyan, mainly because he was afraid that Huyan Huanyan would do something outrageous, so he said goodbye to Xiao Dingfeng and returned home.
Xiao Dingfeng looked at Huyan Moyan leaving and said to Liu Yu: "Do you think Lao Qi can be recognized by Huyan Moyan?"
Liu Yu stood aside, thinking, you said that, what will happen if he doesn't admit it? He did not dare to resist the order, but he still replied: "Your Majesty, the Seventh Highness, is one of the best among men. He will definitely be recognized by the Prime Minister."
Xiao Dingfeng didn't say anything, just smiled, picked up the memorial, and continued to review it.
Xiao Feng left the palace and got into the carriage directly. Xu Chu drove away. As soon as he arrived at the Han Palace, Xiao Feng asked Cao Zhengchun to call Jia Xu and went to the study.
When everyone arrived in the study, Xiao Feng told the story about the marriage. For a while, everyone was silent. After a moment of silence, Jia Xu said to Xiao Feng: "Your Highness, the marriage is a great opportunity for you, and His Majesty is resolute, so no matter how you resist, it will be ineffective, and His Majesty said That's right, you really don't have the power above the court, so your majesty will directly ask the Prime Minister to stand behind you, which can give us a lot of help. I will now ask Yuan Tiangang to send some information about the Prime Minister's Mansion, and also ask some people to protect Huyan Huanyan. I am afraid that after this news gets out, some people will take action against the Prime Minister's Mansion. "
"Well, you go make arrangements now. Remember, arrange some experts to make sure nothing goes wrong." Xiao Feng replied after listening to Jia Xu's analysis.
"Cao Zhengchun, are there any major events in the house recently?"
"Back to Your Highness, no, the Imperial Guards who came before have all joined the establishment of the Han Palace. Gao Kai has also broken through the Yellow Rank and is now a master of the Xuan Rank. The people from Dragon Guard Villa and Jinyi Guard have also been arranged into the establishment of 300 people. Xiao Shunzi also told me about the distribution of forces in the palace, and I also informed Jia Xu."
"Gao Kai has reached the Xuan level so soon?" Xiao Feng was also very confused. He was clearly at the fourth level of the Yellow level before.
"Yes, Divine Doctor Hua has made a lot of elixirs, and the side effects are minimal. Recently, the bad guys and the staff of Hulong Villa have been improved to varying degrees, so Jiao Xu asked Gao Kai and others to start taking the elixirs. But after Xuanjie, Jia Xu asked them to stop first."
"Well, you did a good job. No matter what, there is nothing wrong with improving your strength."
Xiao Feng found some elixirs, exercises, and weapons from the system warehouse, and gave them to Cao Zhengchun, asking him to complete the rewards and send them to Gao Kai and the others. The most important thing was to improve their loyalty. After all, Cao Zhengchun was very skilled in these things, but if anyone dared to betray, just kill them. After all, they were his soldiers and no one could control them.
After Cao Zhengchun took the things and left, Xiao Feng started practicing again. Hua Tuo also refined a lot of elixirs, which he could take all the time. For him, these elixirs had almost no side effects.
